notes.title: The Valley of the Architects is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey All,

The Valley of the Architects is finally out! Play it now. The valley is a tough challenge even for the best puzzlers but once you get your footing you'll have a great time!

Not sure if its for you? Grab the demo!

Happy puzzling,
Mike
